container_purchase: replace with higher tier; transfer existing tail fish if remaining room fits
overflow: Store if remaining room fits. Otherwise a fish above10kg may use one empty stern slot, even below an upgraded container total capacity; release only if neither route applies.

shop_hours.closing: reject entry/trade; return from shop or its container view to shore

line_damage: Each overload/range break rolls once:10% destroys the current rig, removes ownership, selects a spare and requests a save;90% preserves the active rig. Slack/missed/early losses and animation frames never roll damage.
free_fine_rig: When coins<120 and no intact fine rig is owned, either tackle merchant grants one free, regardless of cargo/other rigs; equip and save, no duplicates.

umbrella.protection: No further rain wetness; existing wetness dries at normal sheltered rate.

noodles.stacking: Shared refreshment slot with hot latte; last purchase replaces previous effect.

lifelike_lure.ownership: Existing positive stock stays owned; one purchase unlocks, duplicate purchases do not charge.

rod_line_compatibility: Bamboo rod supports fine/general rigs only. Strong/heavy and8-carrier PE rigs require fiberglass or better. Preserve ownership and choose an owned compatible rig for legacy bamboo combinations.
